chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Sulayman ibn Sam'ah from his uncle Asim al-Kufi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When my Ummah avoids its beggars and walks proudly, my Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, swears by His honor, saying: I will surely punish some of them by means of others.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence when the Muslim community neglects beggars and walks in pride?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) highlights the spiritual decay of the Ummah when they become indifferent to the needy while displaying haughty arrogance. The divine oath underscores the severity of this social neglect, promising that internal strife and reciprocal punishment will befall the community as a direct consequence of their collective failure in social justice.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “When my Ummah avoids beggars and walks proudly, Allah will swear by His honor and  say:  I  will  punish  these  people  because  of  some  of them.”
